episodes.title: Free, Unbound by Anyone
episodes.summary: Chloe decides to leave her life as an agent behind to start over as "Victoria Sellars" and seek her happiness.

episodes.title: No One Should Feel Sorry for Me
episodes.summary: After finding a job and a place, Victoria is reunited with Jeffrey.

episodes.title: I Couldn't Become Someone to Be Depended Upon
episodes.summary: Victoria and Jeffrey attend the royal ball, and an incident happens.

episodes.title: Are You Going to Arrest Me?
episodes.summary: After being followed, Victoria takes down a mysterious man in mask.

episodes.title: Prepared to Pay for What I've Done
episodes.summary: Victoria gets the attacker from the dance party out of prison.

episodes.title: Think About This Child's Happiness
episodes.summary: Just when Victoria seems to be gaining allies, a Barone shows up and asks to adopt Nonna.

episodes.title: I Made Great Memories
episodes.summary: Nonna comes back, but Victoria makes a decision to leave.

episodes.title: I Am Truly Thankful
episodes.summary: Victoria and Nonna live in Randall under aliases, and Jeffrey resign his job to find Victoria.

episodes.title: No Matter What Happens in the Future
episodes.summary: Jeffrey finds Victoria at the Cadiz summer festival, and they confess their secrets to each other.
